title: HK416 A5
summary: 纯手写 WebGL、零依赖的 19 部件 HK416：扣扳机、上膛、换弹、弹匣插拔、抛壳口与翻转照门，爆炸图经碰撞校验。
prompt:
设计一个HK416展示模型。
1. 支持部件交互，如扳机扣动发射，上膛，弹夹插拔，抛弹口可拉开
2. 支持爆炸图演示，零件拆出不互相碰撞
3. 支持换弹
notes: Raw WebGL 1.0, single file, no CDN or assets. 19 procedural parts (rounded boxes, extruded profiles, a swept curved magazine, a helix spring, canvas-baked markings). Explosion uses per-part straight lanes with staggered easeOut. An in-page swept-AABB audit (t=0..1, 0.02 steps) reports 0 collisions and all 37 mated pairs separated by t≈0.40; the strict audit window starts at t=0.45. Assembled neighbours intentionally interpenetrate (BCG inside the receiver, magazine in the well, spring in the tube), so only overlap after separation counts as failure. Trigger / charging handle / magazine / ejection cover / folding sights / selector are clickable and draggable; swapping mags, hold-open, dry fire, and a full reload are modelled with separate chamber and magazine round counts. WebAudio is synthesized on the first gesture. The camera fit optically centers the projected silhouette in the UI safe area; labels auto-hide under 900 px. Verified in headless Chrome at 1280×800, 390×844 and 1600×1000. 46.9k tris, 54 draw calls. Proportions are stylized (≈0.91 m overall), not a gunsmithing reference.
